PATENT ASSIGNMENT

WHEREAS, Ottoline Vasquez-Ferreira, an individual residing in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and Kwabena Osei-Mensah, an individual residing in Ypsilanti, Michigan (each an "Assignor" and together the "Assignors"), are the inventors of certain inventions and improvements described in the patents and applications identified on Schedule A attached hereto (collectively, the "Patents");

WHEREAS, Lattice Photonics, Inc., a Delaware corporation having a place of business at 1400 Huron Parkway, Ann Arbor, Michigan 48104 ("Assignee"), desires to acquire the entire right, title, and interest in and to the Patents;

NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, each Assignor agrees as follows.

1. Assignment.

Each Assignor hereby irrevocably sells, assigns, transfers, and conveys to Assignee, and Assignee hereby accepts, all of that Assignor's entire right, title, and interest in and to: (a) the Patents; (b) all inventions and improvements disclosed or claimed in the Patents; (c) all applications, provisionals, continuations, continuations-in-part, divisionals, reissues, reexaminations, renewals, and extensions of the Patents, in the United States and in every foreign country; (d) all rights of priority under the Paris Convention and the Patent Cooperation Treaty; (e) all rights to sue for and collect damages, profits, and other remedies for past, present, and future infringement of the Patents, including the right to sue in Assignor's own name if required; and (f) all proceeds of the foregoing. This assignment is effective as of the earlier of the date of execution and the date each Assignor conceived or first reduced the inventions to practice.

2. Recordation.

Each Assignor authorizes and requests the Commissioner for Patents to record this assignment against the Patents in the records of the United States Patent and Trademark Office under 35 U.S.C. § 261, and to issue any patent maturing from the Patents to Assignee as assignee of the entire interest.

3. Further Assurances.

Each Assignor shall, without further consideration but at Assignee's expense, execute and deliver all further documents, and take all further actions, that Assignee reasonably requests to perfect, record, prosecute, maintain, defend, or enforce the Patents, including the execution of declarations, powers of attorney, assignments in a form required by any foreign patent office, and papers necessary to prosecute any application or to file any continuation, divisional, reissue, or reexamination. Each Assignor irrevocably appoints Assignee as that Assignor's attorney-in-fact, with full power of substitution, to execute and file any such document if that Assignor is unable or unwilling to do so after reasonable written request; this power is coupled with an interest and is irrevocable.

4. Testimony and Cooperation.

Each Assignor shall, at Assignee's expense, communicate to Assignee all facts known to that Assignor concerning the Patents, testify in any legal proceeding, and otherwise cooperate in the prosecution and enforcement of the Patents. Assignee shall reimburse each Assignor's reasonable out-of-pocket expenses and, for time spent at Assignee's request after that Assignor's employment ends, shall pay that Assignor $150 per hour.

5. Representations and Warranties.

Each Assignor represents and warrants that: (a) that Assignor is a named inventor of the inventions claimed in the Patents; (b) that Assignor has not assigned, licensed, encumbered, or otherwise transferred any right in the Patents to any person other than Assignee, and no such right is subject to any lien; (c) that Assignor has the full right and authority to make this assignment; (d) no other person has claimed inventorship or any ownership interest in the inventions; and (e) that Assignor is not aware of any prior art material to patentability that has not been disclosed to Assignee or to the United States Patent and Trademark Office.

6. Prior Obligations.

Each Assignor represents that this assignment does not conflict with any obligation to a prior employer, university, or funding source, and that no invention claimed in the Patents was conceived or reduced to practice using the facilities or funding of any third party except as disclosed on Schedule B.

7. No License Retained.

Each Assignor retains no right, title, interest, or license in or to the Patents, express or implied, and shall not practice any invention claimed in the Patents except with Assignee's prior written consent.

8. Governing Law and Forum.

This assignment is governed by the laws of the State of Michigan, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles, except that questions of patent validity, enforceability, and infringement are governed by the patent laws of the United States. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Washtenaw County, Michigan.

9. Binding Effect; Counterparts.

This assignment binds each Assignor and that Assignor's heirs, executors, administrators, and successors, and inures to the benefit of Assignee and its successors and assigns. It may be executed in counterparts, and a signature delivered electronically has the same effect as an original.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, each Assignor has executed this Patent Assignment on the date written beside that Assignor's signature.
